evidence: The surface morphology was studied by SEM and a Bruker Multimode 8 atomic force microscope (AFM). The crystalline phase and composition of the films was analysed with a Bruker D8 X-ray diffractometer (XRD) and an INVIA Raman Spectrometer (test wavelength: 785nm, laser power: 5 %). The purity, oxidation state and composition of MnOx films were determined with Thermo ESCALAB 250Xi X-ray photoelectron spectroscope (XPS).
